Leslie Bolden   August 31, 2026 2:42 pm

Trump Approval Sinks To New Second-Term Low As Rubio Gains In Early 2028 Primary Test

President Donald J. Trump

President Donald Trump’s job approval rating dropped to 41%, marking a new low for his second term, according to weekly tracking poll data from Morning Consult released Monday.
